newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech crown steady against mark, may firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: Czech crown steady against mark, may firm slightly.

text.p: 0830 GMT - Czech crown little changed against mark and seen trading in narrow range this week in the absence of market-moving factors, dealers say.
* Crown trades at 18.536 to the mark, after 18.539 late on Tuesday, and at 32.344 to the dollar, after 32.257 on Tuesday.

* Dealers said there could be some appreciation of the crown later in the day. However, they said the currency would probably trade in a range of 18.5-18.6 to the mark for the rest of the week with no new economic indicators expected before June CPI data on July 8.
